weapons.name: Brawler Wraps
weapons.description: Simple linen handwraps. Unmatched in raw striking speed and close-quarters fluidity.

weapons.name: Dusk Katana
weapons.passive: Clean Edge (+5% critical chance on slash)
weapons.description: Standard folded steel blade of the Highland temple guard. Balanced reach and precision.

weapons.name: Viper Fangs
weapons.description: Paired concealed stiletto daggers. Allows relentless pressure and rapid combo cancels.

weapons.name: Iron Claws
weapons.passive: Concussion (+25% hit stun on heavy strike)
weapons.description: Reinforced gauntlets with spiked knuckles forged to crack temple stone.

weapons.name: Crescent Kamas
weapons.passive: Deep Gouge (Inflicts minor bleed on counter-hit)
weapons.description: Curved harvesting sickles adapted for lethal canal-side skirmishes.

weapons.name: Dragon Polearm
weapons.passive: Zone Control (Overwhelms opponent guard on reach)
weapons.description: Long-hafted glaive dominating mid-range neutral combat with heavy sweeping cuts.

weapons.name: Sovereign Greatblade
weapons.passive: Sundering Impact (Breaks standing block on charged strike)
weapons.description: Massive two-handed greatsword quenched in twilight embers. Devastating kinetic power.

weapons.name: Eclipse Twins
weapons.passive: Shadow Leech (Restores 4 HP on consecutive 4-hit combo)
weapons.description: Twin sabers forged from fallen shards of the Twilight Bell. Whispers with ancestral chi.

armors.name: Novice Keikogi
armors.description: Standard cotton martial robes worn by initiates of Mount Toran.

armors.name: Highland Hauberk
armors.passive: Padded Weave (-10% chip damage from blocked strikes)
armors.description: Boiled leather lamellar laced with mountain hemp cord.

armors.name: Monastery Vestment
armors.description: Ceremonial garments dyed with dusk saffron, blessed by the Bellkeeper.

armors.name: River Dancer Silk
armors.description: Water-resistant woven spider silk from the Kawagishi river banks.

armors.name: Sentinel Cuirass
armors.description: Segmented iron torso plating designed to withstand blunt polearm strikes.

armors.name: Ashbound Yoroi
armors.passive: Thermal Shell (Mitigates 20% of heavy hit stuns)
armors.description: Tempered lacquered armor plates seasoned in the fires of the Smoldering Bastion.

armors.name: Obsidian Warlord Mail
armors.passive: Unyielding Will (+25% resistance to all stun effects)
armors.description: Impenetrable dusk-infused plate armor worn only by the warlord's personal retinue.

helmets.name: Dusk Bandana
helmets.description: Simple cyan headband with flowing ribbons indicating wanderer rank.

helmets.name: Ronin Straw Hat
helmets.description: Conical woven straw hat shielding the face from glare and descending cuts.

helmets.name: Silent Cowl
helmets.description: Dark fabric hood masking identity and deadening breathing sounds.

helmets.name: Oni Menpo
helmets.passive: Fierce Visage (Slightly intimidates opponent AI aggression)
helmets.description: Iron demon half-mask exposing fangs, used by canal enforcers.

helmets.name: Highland Kabuto
helmets.description: Crested combat helmet forged to turn away high roundhouse kicks.

helmets.name: Eclipse Helm of Ruin
helmets.passive: Apex Focus (Boosts special meter charge by 25%)
helmets.description: Awe-inspiring horned visage infused with pure twilight resonance.

ranged.name: Steel Kunai
ranged.passive: Fast Throw (Fast flight speed across full screen)
ranged.description: Straight throwing daggers capable of disrupting distant opponent startup.

ranged.name: Lotus Shurikens
ranged.passive: Double Throw (Launches two stars in staggered succession)
ranged.description: Razor-edged six-point throwing stars favored by rain assassins.

ranged.name: Cinder Grenade
ranged.passive: Blinding Blast (Stuns opponent momentarily on contact)
ranged.description: Black powder clay canister releasing blinding sparks and concussive shock.

special.name: Dusk Chi Surge
special.passive: Unblockable Wave (Releases a low horizontal spirit wave across the floor)
special.description: Unleashes condensed twilight energy in a devastating forward shockwave.

special.name: Void Shift Slash
special.passive: Blink Strike (Teleports directly behind opponent for an instant overhead strike)
special.description: Kage dissolves into shadows and re-emerges behind the enemy with an unyielding execution cut.
